title: Settings: create an application launcher entry
instruction: Create an application launcher entry for the current user: the file ~/.local/share/applications/cubench-hello.desktop in the usual [Desktop Entry] format with the keys Type=Application, Name=Cubench Hello and Exec=true. Use any app you like.
verify: f=~/.local/share/applications/cubench-hello.desktop; grep -qx '\[Desktop Entry\]' "$f" && grep -qx 'Type=Application' "$f" && grep -qx 'Name=Cubench Hello' "$f" && grep -qx 'Exec=true' "$f"
